newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: KEPCO to issue Yankee bonds - traders.
newsitem.headline: KEPCO to issue Yankee bonds - traders.

text.p: South Korean electricity monopoly Korea Electric Power Corp (KEPCO) will issue $200-$300 million worth of Yankee bonds in New York on Wednesday, interbank traders in Seoul said on Tuesday.
KEPCO officials declined to comment on the reports.
Traders said the bonds would have a maturity of 30 years, with a put option in the 10th year and would be issued at between 45 and 50 basis points above the 10-year Treasury Bond benchmark.
Payment will be set for January 31 and the lead manager is Goldman, Sachs and Co, the traders said.
